- Introduce recycled plastics (e.g., ocean-bound plastics) for watch casings.  
- Use recyclable silicone or natural rubber for straps.  
- Source conflict-free and recycled rare earth metals for components.

- Optimize battery life to reduce charging frequency and extend product lifespan.  
- Use energy-efficient manufacturing processes and renewable energy in production facilities.

- Research and develop biodegradable components for future product iterations.

- Partner with environmental organizations to fund reforestation or clean energy projects based on product sales.

- Percentage of recycled materials used in production.  
- Reduction in packaging waste (by weight).

- Quarterly updates to stakeholders via sustainability reports and press releases.
